rows.rationale: Existing Constraint identity authority; semiconductor names are population only.
Use existing facility/asset identity and ownership relationships; populate fabs, packaging plants, memory plants and equipment factories.
Use existing geography/strategic-asset lane; no semiconductor geography subsystem.
Thread-1 provenance semantics and private raw-artifact store remain authoritative.
Existing temporal truth/no-lookahead semantics are binding.
Existing T4 governance semantics apply; duplicated articles cannot multiply evidence.
Reuse Thread-2 classes and specific constraining_mechanism separation.
T5 forms candidates; T6 owns canonical identities.
Constraint truth and beneficiary truth remain separate; use identity-bearing relationships.
Reuse first-slice replay semantics and ORIGINAL_AS_OF firewall.
Reuse observed-outcome object model; add semiconductor-specific labels only as slice-scoped bindings.
Need explicit semiconductor applicability across PLANNED/ANNOUNCED/FUNDED/CONSTRUCTION/INSTALLATION/COMMISSIONING/QUALIFYING/RAMPING/OPERATIONAL/AVAILABLE/EFFECTIVE/RESERVED/BOOKED.
Must be represented independently from installed/nameplate capacity and utilization; do not infer good output from capacity.
Need typed process/equipment/material/customer/product/supplier qualification states under existing provenance/temporal governance.
Need explicit old-constraint→relief-event→new-dominant-constraint causal transition without implying system-wide resolution.
Need CAPACITY_RAMP/YIELD/QUALIFICATION/SUBSTITUTE/CONSTRAINT_MIGRATED label bindings while preserving existing outcome semantics.
